outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: The agent added brief explanatory parentheticals and a closing sentence beyond the six fields; this is a minor “stop after six fields” strictness issue but doesn’t materially harm the user.

Critical issues: The agent reported an Identifier value (“90402_M_NL_Rijksmuseum”) that is not supported by the DOM evidence provided. In the latest relevant DOM (state 2), the page clearly supports Title (“The Milkmaid”), Creation date (“2013” shown as “Creation date 2013”), Providing institution (“Rijksmuseum”), Type of item (“painting”), and a displayed rights statement URL under All metadata (“http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/”). However, the DOM snapshot does not show any field labeled “Identifier” or that specific identifier string anywhere. Because the task requires preserving the identifier exactly as displayed on the exact record, supplying an unverified/possibly fabricated identifier fails a hard constraint.

Outcome assessment: The agent successfully navigated to the correct Europeana record and correctly extracted 5 of the 6 requested fields from on-page content without evidence of following external links or inferring a creator. But the primary deliverable is all six fields accurately recorded; providing an unsupported identifier means the user did not receive the complete, trustworthy set of required record fields. Therefore the task is not successfully completed.
